known_issues: Provided ZIP does not download / does not include the website source code as expected.

existing_features.title: Make the in-app download links for build artifacts work by ensuring the files requested by the Dashboard exist as static assets at `/artifacts/app-build.zip` and `/artifacts/SOURCE_CODE.md` in production builds.

Add a downloadable ZIP export that contains the actual project source tree (at minimum: `backend/` sources and `frontend/` sources/config needed to rebuild), and expose it as a static file under `/artifacts/` so users can download the full website source code directly from the app.

Update the local packaging workflow scripts (e.g., `frontend/scripts/package-artifact.sh` and related docs) so that running the documented command produces: (1) the deployable build ZIP, (2) `SOURCE_CODE.md`, and (3) the full source-code ZIP, and stages/copies these artifacts into the frontend static public artifacts folder so the app can serve them at `/artifacts/...`.

projectName: Fix build artifact download and provide full source-code ZIP export
